feeds.title: Pizza Marketplace Blog
feeds.description: PizzaMarketplace.com is the premier online destination for C-level pizza executive leadership seeking cutting-edge intelligence for their multiunit restaurant concepts. Our coverage seeks to unearth trends before they manifest, and teach executives through the words and experiences of their colleagues, via insightful editorial, industry leader-penned blogs, and our yearly face-to-face summits.

feeds.title: Half Baked Harvest
feeds.description: Here you will find unique, creative and fun recipes for everyone in the family to enjoy.

feeds.title: Uuni Blog
feeds.description: A blog on Wood-Fired Oven Recipes, Videos and How-to's. Uuni is worlds first portable wood-fired oven. It heats up to 500C/ 930F in 10 minutes meaning you can cook at pizza in less than 60 seconds!

feeds.title: Baking Steel Blog
feeds.description: Home of Baking Steel, the revolutionary ultra-conductive pizza baking surface made of steel. The Baking Steel heats evenly and produces the best pizza ever made at home. In this blog you can find different pizza and baking recipes.

feeds.title: I Dream Of Pizza
feeds.description: Some people dream about winning the Powerball jackpot, making love to a supermodel, or scoring the winning touchdown in the Super Bowl. While that all sounds great, I've been known to spend most of my time dreaming about digging into a mouth-watering slice of pizza. Since 2008, I've chronicled my pizza eating adventures in New York City & around the world on I Dream Of Pizza -- the web's most popular blog dedicated entirely to pizza. I Dream Of Pizza contains hundreds of reviews of pizzerias in more than 30 states & 20 countries.

feeds.title: Thursday Night Pizza
feeds.description: Peggy Paul Casella, a cookbook editor and writer based in Philadelphia, and the creator of ThursdayNightPizza.com. Every Thursday night she crafts a new pizza based on fresh, seasonal ingredients. Her blog, Thursday Night Pizza, is her chronicle experiments and offer inventive, easy-to-make recipes so that anyone can follow along.

feeds.title: NEPA Pizza Review
feeds.description: Professional Pizza maker and enthusiast turned Pizza Blogger sharing my honest opinions on all of the great Pizzerias in NEPA! Check out my reviews to find new places, save time and money! Also read insider social media and pizza tips for pizzeria owners and at home pizza enthusiasts!

feeds.title: Pizza Review Time
feeds.description: We started Pizza Review Time during the COVID-19 pandemic. During this time many restaurants were only open for carry-out and struggled with business. It was our hope that by going around and doing a weekly video trying out new Pizza places it would help draw some people to them.

feeds.title: Pizza Quixote
feeds.description: Pizza Quixote is your one-stop portal to the weird, wonderful, and downright delicious world of breakout pizzas Dig into the stories behind the pies, meet the passionate pizzaiolos pushing boundaries, and uncover hidden gems and secret pizza havens, both near and far.

feeds.title: Proud Italian Cook
feeds.description: Marie, a wife, mother, mother-in-law, and gramma of two beautiful girls. Her passion is food, clear and simple but especially Italian food, hence the name of her blog is Proud Italian Cook.

feeds.title: Pizza University & Culinary Arts Center Blog

feeds.title: Indy Pizza Blog
